name: Lichess
steps:
1. Go to https://lichess.org
2. Play instantly without an account, or sign up for free to save games
3. Choose a time control (bullet, blitz, rapid, classical) and start a game
4. Use the Learn menu for puzzles, tactics trainer, and studies

name: Chess.com (free tier)
steps:
1. Go to https://www.chess.com
2. Create a free account
3. Play daily games and puzzles within the free daily limits
4. Explore the free Learn lessons and puzzle rush

name: Lichess Puzzles
steps:
1. Go to https://lichess.org/puzzle
2. Solve the tactic shown on the board
3. Adjust difficulty with the rating filter or try Puzzle Storm for timed practice

name: Chess.com Puzzles
steps:
1. Go to https://www.chess.com/puzzles
2. Solve the daily puzzle and tactic themes
3. Use free daily puzzle allowance; premium puzzles are optional

name: Lichess Tactics Trainer
steps:
1. Go to https://lichess.org/training
2. Select Tactics Trainer
3. Solve positions adapted to your rating; track progress over time

name: Lichess Opening Explorer
steps:
1. Go to https://lichess.org/explorer
2. Browse openings by move or ECO code
3. See statistics from millions of Lichess games for each line

name: 365Chess.com Opening Database
steps:
1. Go to https://www.365chess.com/opening.php
2. Search openings by name or ECO code
3. Browse annotated games and transpose into lines

name: Lichess Studies (endgame studies)
steps:
1. Go to https://lichess.org/study
2. Browse community-created studies, including endgame studies
3. Play through positions move by move to learn endgame technique

name: Lichess Endgame Training
steps:
1. Go to https://lichess.org/practice/endgame
2. Practice essential endgames (king and pawn, rook endgames, etc.)
3. Play against the computer from each starting position
